Thanks Beth — got the COI and W-9. Quick clarifications so we can move the vendor activation forward:

1) Endorsement: Our standard requirement is an additional insured endorsement on the commercial general liability policy naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as an additional insured, plus a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood where available. A certificate alone may not be sufficient for activation.

2) Insurer details: please add the insurer NAIC number and the policyholder name exactly as it appears on the policy. We also need the policy effective and expiration dates (mm/dd/yyyy).

3) PO timing: Procurement will issue a conditional PO once we receive either the endorsement or written confirmation from the carrier that the additional insured endorsement will be provided. Full PO issuance (final PO number and routing to Finance) typically follows within 2-3 business days after we validate the endorsement.

4) Invoicing: For now use: Redwood Inference, Accounts Payable, 1234 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103 and invoices@redwood.com. We'll confirm remit details with Finance.

I'm attaching our vendor_onboarding_checklist to make the remaining items explicit. Could you reply with the endorsement or a contact at your broker who can provide the endorsement worksheet?

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — cc'ing Neha from procurement to track.

—Marissa Cole

Marissa — reviewed the COI. Notes and next steps: 

- COI looks standard; it lists limits for GL and cyber but does NOT include an additional insured endorsement. Per our vendor policy, we require an additional insured endorsement for vendors doing integration work that touches production systems.

- Acceptable alternatives: (a) the insurer adds Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured via CG 20 10 (or equivalent) and provides the endorsement page; OR (b) the broker provides a signed letter confirming the endorsement will be issued prior to commencement of work and attaching the endorsement schedule. Option (a) preferred.

- Action I will take: I'll send GreenGrid a procurement acceptance template and a conditional PO template that includes the clause: "PO will be finalized upon receipt of requested endorsement and verification of policy dates." I will also copy Finance for PO issuance.

- Timeline: once we get the endorsement the conditional PO -> final PO flow should be 1-3 business days. I'll request the broker contact and push for same-day handling.

Attachments we will send to GreenGrid: procurement_acceptance_template.docx (procurement), conditional_po_stub.pdf (for visibility).
